title: No laser charge into a lightning holder's reach: do not start a charge on a target seen holding lightning within 54 m; gun or lightning leads instead (LASER_SHORT_GUARD_ON)
behaviors: when the laser would take the lead and start a new charge (charge 0) on a target whose visible weapons include lightning and that is within 54 m, the laser does not lead; lightning or the gun lead and fire as usual; t >= 10; champion behavior on drop run/hold ticks
decision: FAILED (builder checklist item 3, HARD): drop-ring arrival total on base 0 is 3 vs champion 5 after the one allowed fix (seed 44)
blocker: Checklist item 3 fails on base 0 (drop-ring arrivals 3 < 5) for both the first build and fix 1; the brief allows one fix only. Branch pushed with LASER_SHORT_GUARD_ON=false (no flip commit).
next_action: Grok: decide retire vs hold. Not eligible for a slot (item 3 HARD fail; fix 1 also changes the score in only 2/384 games).
single_decision: Which weapon leads against a lightning holder inside its reach. Lightning beats laser: a lightning hit on a laser holder wipes any charge in progress and blocks a new one for short_s 2 s (protocol.md:306, :312; sim engine.ts:327-332, :352), and while charging we move at half speed (protocol.md:305). The champion never reads the short effect (no 'short' handling in brain.ts) and picks the laser first whenever it is off cooldown with a clear line in range (brain.ts:1029), so inside lightning reach it keeps re-trying a charge that the arc keeps wiping, with the torso on the beam aim instead of the gun's lead aim.
trigger: LASER_SHORT_GUARD_ON AND obs.t >= 10 AND the laser would take the lead (clear target, laser cooldown <= 0, d <= laser range, brain.ts:1029) AND laser charge == 0 AND the target's weapons (obs.mechs[i].weapons, or the remembered Known.weapons) include 'lightning' AND its distance <= 54 m (lightning range 45 m x 1.2, one Tesla coil; enemy upgrades are not observable) AND NOT dropMove AND NOT dropHold AND NOT dropNear.
hook: brain.ts act(), weapon lead choice brain.ts:1029: add `&& !(LASER_SHORT_GUARD_ON && obs.t >= 10 && (w(laser).charge ?? 0) <= 0 && (m.weapons ?? known.get(m.id)?.weapons ?? []).includes("lightning") && d <= SHORT_GUARD_M && !dropMove && !dropHold && !dropNear)` so the else-branches (lightning :1032, gun :1035) lead. A charge already in progress is released by the champion's rules. dropNear is the P29 test (brain.ts:853) lifted above the target block. Flag + SHORT_GUARD_M in params.ts.
gates: Cannot start before t = 10 s (explicit). No movement change; on a tick with dropMove or dropHold or a claimable drop within DROP_RUN_M the champion's weapon choice is used. Off = champion exactly.
drop_gate: Plain gate (no drop listed) keeps 11/192 and 10/192 games (the second set is at the bar); the narrow gate (spec) keeps 13/192 and 15/192. A weapon-choice rule cannot displace a drop run, but the gate is kept so the drop run's fight is exactly the champion's. Plain gate = obs.drops is empty. Narrow gate = no drop with holder null or us within DROP_RUN_M (200 m), the same `dropNear` test P29 uses (brain.ts:853), and the champion's dropMove/dropHold are both off on that tick.

evidence.protocol: protocol.md:306 lightning: 'Short: a mech it hits that holds a laser loses any charge in progress and can't start one for short_s 2 s'; protocol.md:312 'Lightning beats laser (short)'; protocol.md:305 laser 0.75 s charge at half move speed. Lightning range 45 m, 60 dmg every 0.25 s (240 DPS before hit rate), Tesla coil +20% range per stack (config.upgrades). Sim models short (engine.ts:327-332, :352).
evidence.sim_retries: Run 3, champion: inside the trigger the laser start fires again and again in one episode (2000+3000: 170 start decisions in 30 episodes, 5.7 per episode; 4000+5000: 119 in 23), the signature of a charge that cannot build while shorted; each of those decisions leads with the beam aim instead of the gun's lead aim.
evidence.sim_any_holder: Run 3: counting any visible lightning holder within 54 m (not only the target), the start happens in 22/192 and 26/192 games; the spec keeps the target-only test as the single decision.
evidence.watcher: coord/data/watcher/final_circle.md: HP in the final circle for laser holders 0.36 (T01-T04) vs 0.74 (T13-T16), small n (8/31 ticks), no conclusion; loadout.md end-of-life laser 53.2% vs 39.0% and lightning 20.0% vs 26.8% (190/205 mech-matches) - top teams carry lasers more, so how the laser is used against a short matters more for them. No Watcher metric counts shorts (not measured).
evidence.first_fights: PR #145 first-fight table: opponent holds a laser and I do not KILL 46 / DIED 156; laser holders win at range, which this rule keeps (it only acts inside 54 m).

estimated_activation: 13/192 and 15/192 games with the narrow drop gate (15 and 16 ungated); 26 and 22 episodes.

B106 AMBUSH_WITH_LASER_ON CLOSE 3.85 (ambush band with an uncharged laser). P34 lethal release (when to let go of a charge) and B32 laser pre-charge behind cover LOSS 3.48 are the other laser-handling tests; none withheld a charge against a lightning holder.
what_would_disprove: Paired screen: no fall in short events on us or in time spent charging inside 54 m of a lightning holder; lower damage dealt or more deaths in those fights (the laser shot mattered more than the short); fires < 10/192; drop-ring set totals below the champion or deaths < 40 s above.
risks: Pins: none (no movement). Drops: none (champion choice on drop ticks). Early deaths: off before 10 s. Combat: a full 315-damage laser shot is given up against a lightning holder at 45-54 m who may not fire its lightning; enemy Tesla-coil stacks are unobservable, so a 64.8 m reach (two stacks) is not covered. Small sample: 13-15 games per set.

trees_on_change: Nearly doubles (trees off on P29: 15 and 16 games). Two things changed at once and were not separated: the champion is now P34 (lethal release can free the laser sooner, so it is ready to start a new charge more often) and trees on hide approaching lightning holders until they are inside 45 m, so more fights start close. The plain gate now passes too (15 and 23).

fix_1.change: The guard acts only while a lightning short on us still blocks a new charge: an `effect: short` event on us within cfg.weapons.lightning.short_s (2 s). Same flag, SHORT_GUARD_M 54, t >= 10 s, drop gates (dropMove/dropHold off, no drop passing the drop run's own candidate filter).
fix_1.why: In the champion, 939 of the 1074 would-fire ticks (87%; 41 of 68 games) came within 2 s of a short on us, when the charge cannot start anyway. The first build fired 4412 ticks (4x): once it held the laser back it kept doing so after the short ended and gave up laser shots that could start. Damage dealt to lightning holders within 54 m fell 202279 -> 183973 and kills 1391 -> 1340 (4 bases), while shorts on us fell only 544 -> 528.

novelty_vs_P34_lethal_release.lethal_release_code: brain.ts (main 9071465, P48 b9492c6) inside `if (laser >= 0) { ... if (charge > 0) {`: LETHAL_RELEASE_ON && !full && lined (leading === 'laser' && beamOn) && !other (no re-aim rescue) && !farmShot && m.kind === 'mech' && m.hp != null && obs.t >= LETHAL_RELEASE_MIN_T (40 s) && !dropOpen() (no dropRun, no drop held by nobody/us within DROP_RUN_M). It computes the partial-charge damage (protocol §7 min_frac curve x cube bonus x cookoff if the target holds a mortar); if LETHAL_RELEASE_MARGIN 0.8 x that >= the target's shown hp, fire[laser] = false lets go of the charge NOW instead of waiting for a full charge.
novelty_vs_P34_lethal_release.lethal_release: Trigger: a charge is ALREADY in progress (charge > 0), lined up on a mech whose shown hp the partial shot would kill, t >= 40 s. Action: RELEASE that existing charge early. Any target loadout.
novelty_vs_P34_lethal_release.P44: Trigger: NO charge in progress (charge == 0) and the laser would take the lead to START one; target seen holding lightning within 54 m; t >= 10 s; (fix 1) a short on us within short_s. Action: the laser does not lead, so no new charge starts and lightning/gun aim leads. It never touches a charge in progress, so it never decides a release.
novelty_vs_P34_lethal_release.same_tick: 0 by construction (charge == 0 vs charge > 0) and measured 0 on every base in both runs.
novelty_vs_P34_lethal_release.same_target_same_game: Champion runs (4 trees-on bases, 384 games): lethal releases 324, of which 26 on a lightning holder within 54 m. P44 original rule would fire on 1074 ticks in 68 games; a lethal release hit the same target id in the same game 30 times in 26 games. P44 fix-1 rule (would fire 939 ticks / 41 games): 9 lethal releases on the same target in 8 games. Flag-on fix 1: guard 918 ticks / 41 games; same-target lethal releases 8 in 7 games; total lethal releases 323 (champion 324), within 54 m of a lightning holder 27 (26).
novelty_vs_P34_lethal_release.conclusion: The two rules are disjoint per tick and cover different decisions (start vs release). They share a target in about 2% of the games (8/384 for fix 1), where a charge started before or after the short is still released by P34 as before.
